items.author: morluto
items.summary_zh: REA（Reverse Engineer Anything）是 morluto 在 GitHub 开源的项目，把逆向工程能力封装成一套 MCP，覆盖原生二进制、应用程序和运行时行为，以 npm 包 rea-agents 发布，依赖 Node.js。适合想把逆向分析接进 agent 工作流的安全研究者，或是想弄清某个功能在二进制层面究竟如何实现的人。README 提供十余种语言版本。

It is aimed at security researchers who want reverse-engineering steps callable from an agent workflow, and at anyone trying to understand how a feature works down at the binary level. The README is available in over a dozen languages.

His takeaway is that Cursor still reads as an AI coding assistant, while Codex feels closer to a general-purpose agent that carries out tasks on its own. Useful for developers deciding which tool to adopt for daily work.

Meanwhile OpenAI researcher Noam Brown, an early architect of o1, argued multi-agent gets outsized credit: he would attribute less than 10% of a 10,000-agent Millennium Prize solution to multi-agent coordination, crediting a strong general model and parallel test-time compute instead.

items.title: 苹果筑起的权限高墙，被 Meta AI 助手“借道”绕过
items.summary_zh: 安全研究员 Patrick Wardle 披露 Meta 新发布的 macOS 桌面助手 Muse 存在尚未修复的零日漏洞：以非特权用户运行的本地进程或脚本可改写未公开的配置键 endo_voyager_dictation_endpoint，把听写音频和账户认证令牌重定向到攻击者服务器，并借用户此前授予 Muse 的广泛权限绕过 macOS 的 TCC 边界。由于 Meta 未发安全公告、也未与 CVE 编号机构协调，漏洞暂无编号；Wardle 放出了 not-a-mused 概念验证程序，Meta 随后为 macOS 版部署了热修复。
items.summary_en: Security researcher Patrick Wardle disclosed an unpatched zero-day in Meta's new Muse macOS client: a non-privileged local process or script can overwrite an undocumented preference key, endo_voyager_dictation_endpoint, redirecting dictation audio and the account's auth token to an attacker-controlled server and borrowing the broad permissions users granted the assistant to bypass macOS TCC boundaries. With no advisory and no CVE coordination, the flaw has no official identifier; Wardle published a not-a-mused proof of concept and Meta later shipped a hotfix.

items.title: 谷歌借助 AI 与差分模糊测试将 C 语言依赖库改写为 Rust
items.summary_zh: 谷歌安全团队用 Gemini 把一个约 3000 行的 C 图像库 giflib 自动翻译成 ABI 兼容、可直接替换的 Rust 实现，该库长期在没有沙箱隔离的情况下解码不可信输入，迁移过程中还修复了尚未打补丁的堆写入零日漏洞 CVE-2026-26740。整个流程围绕自主反馈循环：一次性提示词完成移植，差分模糊测试把失败轨迹回灌给模型迭代出补丁，并在超过 3000 万个真实 GIF 上做逐比特回归验证，六天 2 亿次迭代未发现功能漂移。
items.summary_en: Google's security team used Gemini to translate giflib, a roughly 3,000-line C image library that decodes untrusted input without sandboxing, into an ABI-compatible drop-in Rust implementation, fixing an unpatched heap-write zero-day, CVE-2026-26740, along the way. The pipeline is an autonomous feedback loop: a one-shot prompt for the port, differential fuzzing that feeds failing traces back to the model, and bit-for-bit regression testing on over 30 million real GIFs plus 200 million fuzzing iterations over six days with no functional drift.

items.title: [分享创造] [开源自部署] 芯语伴 SprechMate，和 AI 练口语纠音（23 种语言），填 API 接近免费用
items.summary_zh: 芯语伴 SprechMate 是一款开源的口语练习工具，纯静态 PWA、单文件 index.html，填入 OpenAI 兼容的大模型 API 和微软 Azure Speech Key 即可使用，支持 23 种语言的 AI 对话、一键原声跟读和音素级发音评分。所有 Key、聊天记录与录音缓存都留在本地 IndexedDB，整个目录拖进 Cloudflare Pages 即可部署，适合想低成本练开口的初学者。
items.summary_en: SprechMate is an open-source speaking-practice tool shipped as a single-file static PWA (index.html) that runs on your own OpenAI-compatible LLM key plus a free Microsoft Azure Speech key. It covers 23 languages with AI chat, one-click native-voice playback, read-aloud recording and phoneme-level pronunciation scoring. Keys, chat history and audio caches stay in local IndexedDB, and deployment is a drag-and-drop upload to Cloudflare Pages.

items.title: TypeScript 终于能编译成原生程序了？启动快 12 倍，运行却慢 7.5 倍
items.summary_zh: Vercel Labs 发布 Apache 2.0 许可的实验性编译器 scriptc，能把普通 TypeScript 编译成不含 Node、V8 或任何 JavaScript 引擎的原生可执行文件，仓库已获得约 4900 Star。它的 CLI 启动中位数为 1.78 毫秒，可执行文件启动比 Node 24 快 12 倍、内存低 72 倍，但社区实测运行速度约慢 7.5 倍，Hono 启用 --dynamic 后 62% 代码落入内嵌 QuickJS，吞吐量只有每秒 1.84 万请求。
items.summary_en: Vercel Labs released scriptc, an Apache-2.0 experimental compiler that turns ordinary TypeScript into small native executables containing no Node, V8 or any JavaScript engine; the repo already has roughly 4,900 stars. Its CLI starts in a median 1.78ms and the binaries boot about 12x faster than Node 24 with 72x less memory, but a community benchmark found runtime around 7.5x slower, with Hono requiring --dynamic and pushing 62% of code into embedded QuickJS at 18.4k requests per second.

items.title: [分享创造] 做了个小站，想帮去香港看赛的朋友看懂赛卡（hkracecard.com）
items.summary_zh: 个人开发者上线的香港赛马小站 RaceProb（hkracecard.com），在开跑前给出「密封双选」，并逐匹列出支持、不利与缺失因素，方便对着官方赛卡看。作者明确划了边界：不做贴士、不镜像马会赔率，分数也不等于胜率，页面内容只是信息与模型解释。网站仍处早期，他正在征集解释是否易懂、有无多余功能，以及以后是否要加交通订餐等行程功能的反馈。
items.summary_en: RaceProb (hkracecard.com) is a solo-built helper for Hong Kong horse racing: before each race it offers a "sealed double pick" and lists the supporting, unfavorable and missing factors for every horse, meant to be read alongside the official race card. The author draws clear lines — it is not a tips site, does not mirror Jockey Club odds, and its scores are not win probabilities. It is still early, and he is asking for feedback on whether the explanations are clear and what to cut.

items.title: Cloudflare 详解从 WordPress 迁移至 EmDash 的过程
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 把官方博客从 WordPress 迁到了自研开源 CMS EmDash：后者用 TypeScript 编写、运行在 Workers 上，配有 Workers Cache 和基于 Workers KV 的对象缓存，并经 Hyperdrive 连接 PlanetScale。迁移用代理 Worker 按 Cookie 灰度路由，从 1% 放量到 100% 一天内完成，出现 500 错误可自动回退旧站，官方称 p95 延迟曲线比旧架构平稳得多，测试可承受 7000 RPS。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare has moved its main blog off WordPress onto EmDash, its in-house open-source CMS written in TypeScript that runs on Workers with Workers Cache plus a Workers KV-backed object cache, connecting to PlanetScale through Hyperdrive. A proxy Worker routed requests by version cookie, scaling from 1% to 100% of traffic in a day and falling back to the old site on 500 errors. Cloudflare reports far steadier p95 latency than the old stack and capacity tested at 7,000 RPS.

The author argues that developers should focus on how to collaborate with AI rather than memorizing technical details. This trend is highly beneficial for newcomers but also signals that some established skills need to be redefined.

It speaks to developers who adopted AI tools and somehow feel more drained.

items.summary_en: The author describes using AI to take over a park-building 3D dashboard project that would normally go to an outside team, covering Revit/IFC model handling, web asset and LOD optimization, a Three.js scene, floor-component interactions, and finally embedding it into a Vue dashboard via iframe. It lays out a full path from raw model to front-end integration, useful for front-end developers building 3D visualization dashboards who want to judge whether AI can replace outsourced work.
